findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/fileSize.enforcement.test.ts: 'gives every listed file a reason in plain words': const loaded = await loadOffenderEntries(); ... expect(loaded, ...).not.toBeNull();
findings.obligation: Design ratchet entry: plain-words reason per entry (fileSize.offenders.ts)
findings.observation: loadOffenderEntries returns the raw TOO_WIDE_TODAY value, so a module without that export yields undefined, and expect(undefined).not.toBeNull() passes. The reason test then passes vacuously. The first test still reds in that case, so the oracle as a whole stays red.
findings.remediation: Return null unless TOO_WIDE_TODAY is an array (Array.isArray) and assert on that, so an absent or misnamed export fails the reason test too.

findings.obligation: Design ratchet: entries are paths; first real-tree test names only starting-list files
findings.observation: The helper always prefixes src/. An entry written as src/pages/... becomes src/src/pages/..., and the subset test reports it as a gained name. The path convention is not stated in the failure message, so a crafter gets a misleading growth error.
findings.remediation: Accept both forms (prefix only when the path does not start with src/), as the earlier revision did, or state the relative-to-src convention in the subset test message.
